description: T-67 variant (not a scored figure): 50 case reference houses. One cluster around Interlaken, one stretched up the Rhône valley above Brig (Brig to Goms), the rest spread over Switzerland.

output.description: T-67 variant: 50 case reference houses; Interlaken cluster (il), Brig-Goms cluster (br) and spread across Switzerland (mid).

sources.climate: Daily mean of data/raw/swiss-grid/weather-2025-hourly.csv.gz (Open-Meteo, data/raw/swiss-grid/SOURCE.md); winter = Dec/Jan/Feb 2025, summer = Jun/Jul/Aug 2025; computed by scripts/make_climate_fleet.py, for display only
sources.heating_limit_c: 12 °C daily mean, case heating-day limit (config/reference-house.json HeatingDayThresholdC)
sources.populated: Scenario value (T-67): a cell counts as populated with at least 300 single-family buildings (data/derived/buildings/grid-10km-heat-demand.csv) and model elevation at most 1300 m (data/raw/swiss-grid/grid-10km.csv); the clusters drop the elevation limit (Interlaken: at least 200 single-family buildings)
sources.regions: Scenario values (T-67, user choice): Interlaken centre 46.686 N 7.863 E, radius 16 km; Brig-Goms polyline Brig 46.316 N 7.988 E - Fiesch 46.40 N 8.135 E - Ulrichen 46.505 N 8.31 E, cells within 8 km. Coordinates approximate (TODO(source)), they only choose grid cells
sources.min_spacing_km: Scenario values (T-67): 9.5 km inside a cluster (grid neighbours, 10 km apart in LV95, allowed), 22 km for the spread so points stay apart on the Switzerland map
sources.design_heating_kw: 10 kW, case reference house everywhere (config/reference-house.json), so only the weather differs between houses
sources.formula_divisor_c: 25.6, case reference house (config/reference-house.json), kept everywhere as in the fleet house generator
sources.tank_initial_kwh: 0: tank starts empty as in Core
sources.electricity_price_chf_per_kwh: ElCom 2026 H4 total of the cell's municipality (data/derived/elcom/price-per-municipality-2026.csv)
sources.server_count: 4 per house, comparison value as in the other fleet scenarios (config/reference-house.json ServerCount)
